title: Discover
description: Finding the pages and files by following links from the seeds.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: Start URLs; one breadth-first walk per seed.

allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: Comma separated. Hosts in scope, subdomains included. Empty: every linked host. Required with a login, so the session cookie is sent to the site only.

excludedUrlPatterns.title: Excluded URL patterns
excludedUrlPatterns.description: Substring, or a glob against the whole URL when it contains * or ?. Must contain the logout URL, otherwise the crawler ends its own session.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Safety cap of pages per seed.

fileExtensions.title: File extensions
fileExtensions.description: Links with these extensions are listed as files, not scraped as pages.

downloadHints.title: Download hints
downloadHints.description: Comma separated path substrings that mark a link as a download although its URL has no extension.

fileDomains.title: File domains
fileDomains.description: Comma separated hosts that may serve the files besides the allowed domains, e.g. a CDN or image proxy. The session cookie is never sent to them.
